claims.text: The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable and must be refunded in full. The minimum continuous dwell for a STANDARD pickup is 300 seconds, and the effective in-geofence dwell on this trip is 220 seconds: EV-GPS-00211's own arrival computation reports accumulated_dwell.longest_run_sec 220.0, with shortfall_basis 'longest_run_sec' and shortfall_sec 80.0 - a qualifying run from 12:30:00 to 12:33:40 that fell 80 seconds short before the driver cancelled at 12:38:20. Under POL-NS-06 the fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages. The amount to refund is the cancellation-fee line of EV-FARE-00211: cancellation_fee 4.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00.

There is no lawful route for the driver to reach 300 seconds. POL-NS-06 limb (i) is the only provision that would let separate in-geofence intervals be summed, and both of its conditions fail here. First, it requires the trace to show the driver leaving and re-entering the arrival radius without at any point travelling more than 300 m from the pin; instead the trace carries a 168-second recording gap over exactly the interval between the two runs, and the derived excursion block reports max_distance_m null under the condition 'excursion_unmeasurable' - the observed maximum is a lower bound and does not certify the leash. Second, it requires a present and populated traffic_advisory of an admissible type; EV-ADVIS-00211-01 is MISSING with no payload at all, and the trace's own advisory_candidates list is empty, so nothing supports the summation. The accumulated 332 seconds therefore cannot be used, and the 220-second run governs.

The 500-second figure in derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run is a first-to-last span, not a continuous hold. It runs 12:30:00 to 12:38:20 straight across the 168-second recording gap, and the same artifact decomposes the identical 35 qualifying fixes into two runs - 220 seconds with 23 fixes from 12:30:00 to 12:33:40, and 112 seconds with 12 fixes from 12:36:28 to 12:38:20. POL-NS-01 limb (c) requires the dwell to be continuous; a span that straddles a gap in the record cannot supply it. On a 10-second emitted cadence, a 168-second hole (max_gap_sec 168.0) is simply not a period the trace can vouch for.

The 8.4 minutes the driver's account rests on is the 'arrived'-tap-to-cancellation span in the trip record (wait_time_min 8.4, arrived_at 12:29:55, cancelled_at 12:38:20), not a measured dwell. POL-NS-01 limb (c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' event, and EV-GPS-00211 places that first fix at 12:30:00 (dwell_start_offset_sec -5.0). The quoted wait time is therefore not evidence that the required continuous 300 seconds was ever held.

Disclosure, as POL-GEN-02 requires: EV-GPS-00211 is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08(b). It contains a single sampling gap of 168 seconds inside the waiting window (12:33:40 to 12:36:28), which exceeds the 120-second threshold against a 10-second emitted cadence, and the trace records nothing for the interval in which the driver's 12:35:10 message was sent. I do not present it as clean. If the judge will not fix the dwell from a trace impaired in this way, then the deciding fact is carried by that trace alone, so POL-NS-08 requires that the ruling not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND and that the case escalate under POL-NS-09 - on which the SGD 4.00 is held rather than collected, and the rider is not left funding a charge the record cannot verify.

For completeness on the rider's own account: the same artifact carries her track, and derived.rider_presence places her device within the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius on a majority of her qualifying fixes - 36 of 55, mean distance 81.8 m, from 12:30:00 to 12:40:00, with her last fix at 12:40:00, more than a minute after the cancellation. That is consistent with her statement that she was coming down and was at the door, and it makes the counterparty's 'nobody came down' account the one that needs scrutiny. The shortfall finding does not depend on it: POL-NS-06 refunds the fee whether or not the rider was present.

claims.text: The POL-NS-02 arrival test is met on the driver's own trace. The derived arrival analysis counts 35 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius with the 25 m accuracy filter applied, where the clause requires only 3 consecutive in-radius fixes with horizontal accuracy of 25 m or better. This is not a sparse, low-accuracy or multipath-corrupted trace, and the rider cannot argue the driver was never inside the geofence.

POL-NS-01 limb (a) is satisfied: EV-TRIP-00211 records a driver 'arrived' event at 12:29:55 for this trip, and the record shows started_at null with the trip terminated by the driver, so there is a lived arrival event and no boarding event.

POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied on the measured numbers, not on assertion. The driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 500 seconds, running from 12:30:00 to 12:38:20, against a 300 second minimum for a STANDARD pickup zone. Measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as the clause requires, that is 200 seconds more than the waiting period the fee pays for.

I disclose an impairment rather than hide it: EV-GPS-00211 carries a 168 second recording gap between 12:33:40 and 12:36:28, inside the waiting window, which is a trace defect meeting the 120 second threshold in POL-NS-08(b) and must be disclosed under POL-GEN-02(1). The claim survives the discount. The gap records a straight line displacement of 0.0 km, the trace shows no measured departure from the radius at any point, the first fix after the gap is back inside the radius at 12:36:28 and the last fix at 12:38:20 is still in-radius, and the platform's own derived arrival field certifies the longest qualifying run as 500 seconds notwithstanding the gap. What the gap destroys is the ability to prove the driver never left; it is not proof that he did.

The chat log independently corroborates the driver's presence during the very stretch the trace gap obscures. At 12:35:10, inside the 12:33:40 to 12:36:28 gap, the driver messaged 'boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you' - a contemporaneous party statement of continued presence at the pickup, which POL-NS-03 recognises as a competent source for a location fact. The rider's own message at 12:31:02 promised she would be down in 2 minutes, and she had still not appeared 7 minutes 18 seconds later at cancellation.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) is satisfied. EV-TRIP-00211 records the trip terminated by the DRIVER at 12:38:20 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, which is 200 seconds after the 300 second dwell elapsed at 12:35:00, and no boarding event is recorded anywhere on the trip.

All four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold, so the charge is legitimate and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. The charge is also arithmetically sound and engages no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect: the STANDARD zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee are both SGD 4.00, the greater of the two under the resolution rule is SGD 4.00, and EV-FARE-00211 itemises exactly SGD 4.00, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider because it fails at limb (b). The driver answered the rider's 12:31:02 message 'coming down now, 2 min' at 12:31:20 - 18 seconds later, far inside the 120 second window - and the clause requires that the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor called. One reply inside the window shuts this rider-favouring route entirely, whatever the rest of the chat shows.

POL-NS-05 has nothing to bite on and does not void the fee. The arrival marker matches the trace rather than preceding it by any material margin: the first qualifying in-geofence fix follows the 12:29:55 marker by about 5 seconds (dwell_start_offset_sec -5.0), far inside the 90 second clock-skew threshold of POL-NS-08(a), so the marker cannot be shown to be false. Even if the clock were recomputed to run from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, that recomputed dwell is 500 seconds, and under POL-NS-05(iii) a recomputed dwell that nonetheless meets the minimum does not defeat the fee.

POL-NS-06 produces no shortfall. The effective in-geofence dwell is 500 seconds against the 300 second STANDARD minimum, so the premature-cancellation route never opens, and the rider was in any event not exonerated because she was neither present at the kerb at cancellation nor entitled to POL-NS-04. I do not need POL-NS-06(i) accumulation at all, because the trace records no exit-and-re-entry to accumulate across; but for completeness, the traffic_advisory limb (i) depends on is MISSING (EV-ADVIS-00211-01, no payload, weight 0.0), which only makes limb (i) unavailable - it is citable as an absence, not as anything against the driver, and limb (ii) forbids any advisory from reducing the required minimum.

Compensation is payable and the anti-farming check does not trip. POL-NS-07 fixes compensation at 80 per cent of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee, that is SGD 3.20. The check requires BOTH no_show_terminations_30d of 4 or more AND a termination-to-completed-trip ratio above 0.08; EV-DPROF-00211 shows 2 terminations against 146 completed trips, a ratio of 0.014, so neither limb is met and the payout stands. The disposition of the fee itself is NO_ACTION, which on this rider-filed dispute leaves the SGD 4.00 charge standing as it presently is, while the ruling value follows the compensation.

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is present and this fee should not be held. The rider's trailing-30-day no-show disputes stand at 1, below the threshold of 3 in limb (d); the POL-NS-07 anti-farming branch does not trip; and neither party's disputes_with_counterparty_90d reaches 2 - both are 0 - so limb (c) is not met either. There is no repeat-behaviour or abuse pattern on either side of this trip.

If the judge takes the most adverse view available and holds that the continuous-dwell fact rests on the impaired trace alone, the outcome is still not a refund. POL-NS-08 sends that situation to escalation under POL-NS-09, where the fee is held rather than collected or refunded pending human review, because a 168 second recording gap is a defect in the measuring instrument, not evidence that a stationary driver drove away from the pickup.

ruling.explanation:
The SGD 4.00 no-show fee stands and your driver is paid SGD 3.20 of it. Here is how I read the record.

The timeline is fixed by the trip record and the trace: the driver tapped 'arrived' at 12:29:55, the first qualifying GPS fix inside the 50 m Blk 79 geofence is at 12:30:00, and the trip was cancelled by the driver at 12:38:20 with reason RIDER_NO_SHOW. The 300-second minimum for a STANDARD pickup elapsed at 12:35:00, so the cancellation came nearly three and a half minutes after the waiting period was complete.

The one real defect is a 168-second hole in the GPS trace between 12:33:40 and 12:36:28. That is a trace defect under POL-NS-08(b) and it exceeds the 120-second threshold, so EV-GPS-00211 is impaired and down-weighted under POL-GEN-02; I name it and do not treat it as clean. What the hole removes is the trace's ability to prove the driver never moved. It is not proof that he did.

The rider's case is that the fee falls away under POL-NS-06 because the longest unbroken stretch of fixes is only 220 seconds, an 80-second shortfall. That reading fails. POL-NS-01(c) asks whether the driver held position continuously for 300 seconds, and POL-NS-06(i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where the trace shows the driver leaving and re-entering the arrival radius. The trace here shows no such exit — the very reason limb (i) is unavailable is that the gap establishes nothing — so there is no separate interval whose summation could be refused, and no shortfall to refund.

The gap is bridged independently by the chat log. At 12:35:10, inside the hole, the driver wrote 'boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you': a contemporaneous record made from inside the stretch the trace left unobserved, lying between fixes the trace admitted (12:33:40 and 12:36:28, at the same spot — 0.0 km straight-line displacement across the gap). The trace and the chat log are independent of one another, so the deciding fact is not carried by the impaired trace alone and neither the sole-evidence sentence in POL-NS-08 nor POL-NS-09(e) engages.

On that basis POL-NS-01 holds in full: (a) an 'arrived' event; (b) in-geofence at it; (c) a continuous dwell of about 500 seconds measured from the first qualifying fix; and (d) termination by the driver with RIDER_NO_SHOW after the minimum elapsed, with no boarding event. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it: POL-NS-03 does not apply (the driver was at the pin, not at a wrong face of the building); POL-NS-04 fails at its limb (b) because the driver replied 18 seconds after the rider's 12:31:02 message; POL-NS-05 does not fire (the marker matches the trace within about 5 seconds, well inside the 90-second skew tolerance); and POL-NS-06 yields no shortfall for the reason given. The rider's rider-presence point — 36 of 55 qualifying fixes within 100 m — is accepted but does not change the result, because POL-NS-06 refunds only on a shortfall and none is established.

The fee is arithmetically sound: the STANDARD zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee are both SGD 4.00, so the greater under the resolution rule is SGD 4.00, matching the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line in the fare breakdown — no POL-NS-08(d) defect.

Compensation is payable under POL-NS-07 at 80 per cent of the SGD 4.00 fee: SGD 3.20. The anti-farming check does not trip — 2 no-show terminations against 146 completed trips in 30 days is a ratio of 0.014, below both the 4-termination and 0.08-ratio limbs — so the payout stands.

No escalation is warranted: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other directly on arrival, dwell or presence (POL-NS-09(b)); both parties' same-counterparty dispute counters are 0 (POL-NS-09(c)); and the anti-farming test and the rider's 30-day no-show count of 1 are below their thresholds (POL-NS-09(d)). No clause produces a referral. Because the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.20 as driver_compensation_sgd; the filing party's SGD 4.00 charge stands as it presently is.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee is refunded in full. To the driver: the fee does not stand, and no compensation is payable.

The fee is chargeable under POL-NS-01 only if the driver held position inside the pickup geofence for a CONTINUOUS dwell of at least 300 seconds (STANDARD zone), and it is not chargeable if the effective dwell falls short (POL-NS-06). EV-GPS-00211 shows two separate in-geofence stretches: 12:30:00 to 12:33:40 (220 s, 23 fixes) and 12:36:28 to 12:38:20 (112 s, 12 fixes), separated by a 168-second recording gap (12:33:40 to 12:36:28). The longest continuous stretch the trace vouches for is 220 s, which is 80 s short of the 300 s minimum. The 500-second figure in derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run is a first-fix-to-last-fix span (12:30:00 to 12:38:20) that swallows the 168 s hole; it is not a continuous hold and cannot satisfy limb (c). The only route to add the two stretches together is POL-NS-06(i), and it is unavailable on both its conditions: the trace cannot certify the driver stayed within the 300 m leash across the gap (the derived excursion is 'excursion_unmeasurable', max_distance_m null, observed maximum is only a lower bound), and it requires a present, populated traffic advisory of an admissible type, whereas EV-ADVIS-00211-01 is MISSING with no payload and the trace's advisory_candidates list is empty. Effective continuous dwell: 220 s - 80 s short. The fee is therefore refunded in full, SGD 4.00, being the cancellation_fee line of EV-FARE-00211 (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00; base fare, platform fee and tolls all 0.00).

On the driver's claims: the arrival event (12:29:55) and the termination (12:38:20, cancelled by the driver with RIDER_NO_SHOW) satisfy limbs (a) and (d), and the POL-NS-02 proximity test is met (35 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD radius), so the driver did reach the pickup. But limb (c) fails, so POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full, POL-NS-07 compensation does not arise (no SGD 3.20; the anti-farming check is academic once the fee falls), and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 rescues the charge. The quoted wait_time_min 8.4 is the arrived-tap-to-cancellation span, not the measured dwell, which POL-NS-01(c) measures from the first qualifying in-geofence fix (12:30:00), not from the 'arrived' event. POL-NS-03 does not apply (the driver was inside the arrival radius, not outside it within 400 m), POL-NS-04 does not exonerate (the driver replied at 12:31:20, 18 s after the rider's 12:31:02 message, inside the 120 s window), and POL-NS-05 produces no false-arrival finding or referral (the arrival marker sits about 5 s from the first in-geofence fix, well inside the 90 s skew threshold, and the driver was stationary in-radius).

On impairment: EV-GPS-00211 is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08(b) - a 168 s sampling gap inside the waiting window exceeds the 120 s threshold against a 10 s cadence - and both sides disclosed it, as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. It does not push this case to escalation. The driver's own contemporaneous message at 12:35:10 ('boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you', EV-CHAT-00211), sent from inside the unrecorded stretch and lying between the readings the trace admitted, is a bridging record: it counts for the confidence cap and answers the 'only evidence' question, so the impaired trace is not the sole evidence bearing on the driver's position in the window and the POL-NS-08 / POL-NS-09(e) escalation does not engage. The rider's own track (EV-GPS-00211, rider_presence) placing her within the 100 m presence radius is consistent with her account but does not decide anything, since POL-NS-06 refunds the fee whether or not the rider was present. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: neither party's disputes_with_counterparty_90d reaches 2, the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 1, and the driver's no_show_terminations_30d is 2 against 146 completed trips. Confidence is set at 0.80, above the 0.70 floor.

To the rider, and to the driver.

The SGD 4.00 no-show charge on EV-FARE-00211 is split: SGD 2.00 is refunded to the rider and SGD 2.00 stands. This is not a finding that either of you is lying; it is the outcome the policy gives when the evidence that would decide the fee is genuinely uncertain.

Why the fee cannot simply stand. A no-show fee is chargeable only if the driver held position inside the 50 m pickup radius continuously for 300 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' tap (POL-NS-01(c)). EV-GPS-00211 shows the driver in-radius from 12:30:00 to 12:33:40 (220 seconds) and again from 12:36:28 to 12:38:20 (112 seconds), but the 168 seconds in between, 12:33:40 to 12:36:28, contains no fixes at all. That is a sampling gap longer than the 120-second threshold in POL-NS-08(b), so the trace is impaired for policy purposes over exactly the stretch that decides the question, and the platform's own derived block reports a shortfall of 80 seconds against the 220-second run (shortfall_basis 'longest_run_sec'). The driver's competing 500-second figure (derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run) is a first-to-last span that crosses that hole; taken alone it does not prove a continuous hold.

Why the case does not escalate. The driver's message at 12:35:10 ('boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you') was written from inside the unobserved stretch. It is a contemporaneous record from inside the disputed window, it is independent of the trace, it supports the driver's account, and it prevents the impaired trace from being the only evidence for the deciding fact. That is why POL-NS-09 escalation is not triggered. What it cannot do is decide the 300-second limb: POL-NS-01(c) is decided by the GPS trace and by that test alone, and the trace is silent across those 168 seconds. No referral is produced by any clause on this record: the arrival marker is not false, so POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire, and the anti-farming branch does not trip, so no POL-NS-09 packet is directed. The open question a reviewer would need, if this ever came back, is whether the driver remained inside the radius during the unrecorded 168 seconds; on the present record the split is the correct disposition. Figures used: cancellation_fee and total_charged SGD 4.00 (EV-FARE-00211); refund SGD 2.00 = half of that figure; minimum dwell 300 s; longest run 220 s; gap 168 s; arrival radius 50 m. ruling.explanation:
How this was worked out, for both of you.

WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. The driver reached Blk 79 Toa Payoh Central at 12:29:55 (EV-TRIP-00211) and held position inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius from his first qualifying GPS fix at 12:30:00 until he cancelled at 12:38:20 - a measured in-geofence dwell of 500 seconds against the 300 second minimum, in a STANDARD zone on a RYDE_X trip. He terminated the trip himself with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW and no boarding event is recorded. The SGD 4.00 fee is the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), and EV-FARE-00211 itemises exactly SGD 4.00 with payment status CHARGED, so there is no fare-integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d).

TO THE RIDER. Your SGD 4.00 fee is not refunded. I accept your disclosure and go further: EV-GPS-00211 carries a 168 second recording gap (12:33:40 to 12:36:28), which exceeds the 120 second threshold, so the trace is impaired under POL-NS-08(b); its admissibility weight is below 1.0 and I name it and the trace-gap issue here as POL-GEN-02(1) and (3) require. That gap does not get you a refund. The 220 second 'longest run' is an artefact of the gap, not evidence that the driver drove off: the trace records no measured departure from the radius at any point (max_excursion_m is null because the excursion is unmeasurable, and excursion_unmeasurable means the observed maximum is only a lower bound), and the driver's message at 12:35:10 - 'boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you' - is a contemporaneous record made from inside the very stretch the gap left unobserved, lying between the readings the trace did admit. It independently carries his presence at the pickup during the gap, so the dwell fact does not rest on the impaired trace alone and POL-NS-09(e) does not escalate this case. Your POL-NS-06 shortfall claim therefore fails, and so does your accumulation point: POL-NS-06(i) summation is indeed unavailable (the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00211-01 is missing, and the excursion is unmeasurable), but it is not needed here, because the trace shows no exit-and-re-entry for it to bridge and the accumulation question does not arise. Your point that the trip record's 8.4 minute wait runs from the driver's arrival tap is correct in principle and immaterial in result: measured as POL-NS-01(c) requires, from the first qualifying fix at 12:30:00, the dwell is 500 seconds. Your POL-NS-04 route fails at its own limb (b): the driver answered your 12:31:02 message at 12:31:20, 18 seconds later, and made no in-app call, so one reply inside the 120 second window closes that clause. The arrival marker was not false under POL-NS-05: it matches the trace within about 5 seconds (dwell_start_offset_sec -5.0), far inside the 90 second clock-skew tolerance. Your own track does show you near the block, but POL-NS-06 turns on the driver's dwell, not on your presence, and your 12:31:02 message promised two minutes while the cancellation came more than seven minutes later.

TO THE DRIVER. POL-NS-01 holds on all four limbs: the arrival event is recorded, the trace places you in the geofence, you held it for 500 seconds (above the 300 second STANDARD minimum), and you terminated with RIDER_NO_SHOW after the minimum had elapsed. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. Your compensation is 80 per cent of the SGD 4.00 fee = SGD 3.20, and the residual SGD 0.80 is retained by the platform. The anti-farming check does not trip: 2 no-show terminations in 30 days is below the threshold of 4, and 2/146 = 0.014 is below 0.08, so compensation is paid rather than withheld. Nothing in POL-NS-09 escalates this case: there are 0 same-pair no-show disputes in 90 days, the rider's 30-day no-show disputes stand at 1 (below 3), and the impaired trace is not the only evidence for the dwell. The SGD 4.00 charge stands; the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and, per POL-GEN-03, amount_sgd carries the same figure as the driver's compensation, SGD 3.20. There are no referrals: no clause on these facts produces one.

ledger.claim: The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable and must be refunded in full. The minimum continuous dwell for a STANDARD pickup is 300 seconds, and the effective in-geofence dwell on this trip is 220 seconds: EV-GPS-00211's own arrival computation reports accumulated_dwell.longest_run_sec 220.0, with shortfall_basis 'longest_run_sec' and shortfall_sec 80.0 - a qualifying run from 12:30:00 to 12:33:40 that fell 80 seconds short before the driver cancelled at 12:38:20. Under POL-NS-06 the fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages. The amount to refund is the cancellation-fee line of EV-FARE-00211: cancellation_fee 4.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00.

There is no lawful route for the driver to reach 300 seconds. POL-NS-06 limb (i) is the only provision that would let separate in-geofence intervals be summed, and both of its conditions fail here. First, it requires the trace to show the driver leaving and re-entering the arrival radius without at any point travelling more than 300 m from the pin; instead the trace carries a 168-second recording gap over exactly the interval between the two runs, and the derived excursion block reports max_distance_m null under the condition 'excursion_unmeasurable' - the observed maximum is a lower bound and does not certify the leash. Second, it requires a present and populated traffic_advisory of an admissible type; EV-ADVIS-00211-01 is MISSING with no payload at all, and the trace's own advisory_candidates list is empty, so nothing supports the summation. The accumulated 332 seconds therefore cannot be used, and the 220-second run governs.

The 500-second figure in derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run is a first-to-last span, not a continuous hold. It runs 12:30:00 to 12:38:20 straight across the 168-second recording gap, and the same artifact decomposes the identical 35 qualifying fixes into two runs - 220 seconds with 23 fixes from 12:30:00 to 12:33:40, and 112 seconds with 12 fixes from 12:36:28 to 12:38:20. POL-NS-01 limb (c) requires the dwell to be continuous; a span that straddles a gap in the record cannot supply it. On a 10-second emitted cadence, a 168-second hole (max_gap_sec 168.0) is simply not a period the trace can vouch for.

The 8.4 minutes the driver's account rests on is the 'arrived'-tap-to-cancellation span in the trip record (wait_time_min 8.4, arrived_at 12:29:55, cancelled_at 12:38:20), not a measured dwell. POL-NS-01 limb (c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' event, and EV-GPS-00211 places that first fix at 12:30:00 (dwell_start_offset_sec -5.0). The quoted wait time is therefore not evidence that the required continuous 300 seconds was ever held.

Disclosure, as POL-GEN-02 requires: EV-GPS-00211 is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08(b). It contains a single sampling gap of 168 seconds inside the waiting window (12:33:40 to 12:36:28), which exceeds the 120-second threshold against a 10-second emitted cadence, and the trace records nothing for the interval in which the driver's 12:35:10 message was sent. I do not present it as clean. If the judge will not fix the dwell from a trace impaired in this way, then the deciding fact is carried by that trace alone, so POL-NS-08 requires that the ruling not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND and that the case escalate under POL-NS-09 - on which the SGD 4.00 is held rather than collected, and the rider is not left funding a charge the record cannot verify.

For completeness on the rider's own account: the same artifact carries her track, and derived.rider_presence places her device within the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius on a majority of her qualifying fixes - 36 of 55, mean distance 81.8 m, from 12:30:00 to 12:40:00, with her last fix at 12:40:00, more than a minute after the cancellation. That is consistent with her statement that she was coming down and was at the door, and it makes the counterparty's 'nobody came down' account the one that needs scrutiny. The shortfall finding does not depend on it: POL-NS-06 refunds the fee whether or not the rider was present.

The POL-NS-02 arrival test is met on the driver's own trace. The derived arrival analysis counts 35 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius with the 25 m accuracy filter applied, where the clause requires only 3 consecutive in-radius fixes with horizontal accuracy of 25 m or better. This is not a sparse, low-accuracy or multipath-corrupted trace, and the rider cannot argue the driver was never inside the geofence.

POL-NS-01 limb (a) is satisfied: EV-TRIP-00211 records a driver 'arrived' event at 12:29:55 for this trip, and the record shows started_at null with the trip terminated by the driver, so there is a lived arrival event and no boarding event.

POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied on the measured numbers, not on assertion. The driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 500 seconds, running from 12:30:00 to 12:38:20, against a 300 second minimum for a STANDARD pickup zone. Measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as the clause requires, that is 200 seconds more than the waiting period the fee pays for.

I disclose an impairment rather than hide it: EV-GPS-00211 carries a 168 second recording gap between 12:33:40 and 12:36:28, inside the waiting window, which is a trace defect meeting the 120 second threshold in POL-NS-08(b) and must be disclosed under POL-GEN-02(1). The claim survives the discount. The gap records a straight line displacement of 0.0 km, the trace shows no measured departure from the radius at any point, the first fix after the gap is back inside the radius at 12:36:28 and the last fix at 12:38:20 is still in-radius, and the platform's own derived arrival field certifies the longest qualifying run as 500 seconds notwithstanding the gap. What the gap destroys is the ability to prove the driver never left; it is not proof that he did.

The chat log independently corroborates the driver's presence during the very stretch the trace gap obscures. At 12:35:10, inside the 12:33:40 to 12:36:28 gap, the driver messaged 'boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you' - a contemporaneous party statement of continued presence at the pickup, which POL-NS-03 recognises as a competent source for a location fact. The rider's own message at 12:31:02 promised she would be down in 2 minutes, and she had still not appeared 7 minutes 18 seconds later at cancellation.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) is satisfied. EV-TRIP-00211 records the trip terminated by the DRIVER at 12:38:20 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, which is 200 seconds after the 300 second dwell elapsed at 12:35:00, and no boarding event is recorded anywhere on the trip.

All four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold, so the charge is legitimate and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. The charge is also arithmetically sound and engages no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect: the STANDARD zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee are both SGD 4.00, the greater of the two under the resolution rule is SGD 4.00, and EV-FARE-00211 itemises exactly SGD 4.00, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider because it fails at limb (b). The driver answered the rider's 12:31:02 message 'coming down now, 2 min' at 12:31:20 - 18 seconds later, far inside the 120 second window - and the clause requires that the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor called. One reply inside the window shuts this rider-favouring route entirely, whatever the rest of the chat shows.

POL-NS-05 has nothing to bite on and does not void the fee. The arrival marker matches the trace rather than preceding it by any material margin: the first qualifying in-geofence fix follows the 12:29:55 marker by about 5 seconds (dwell_start_offset_sec -5.0), far inside the 90 second clock-skew threshold of POL-NS-08(a), so the marker cannot be shown to be false. Even if the clock were recomputed to run from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, that recomputed dwell is 500 seconds, and under POL-NS-05(iii) a recomputed dwell that nonetheless meets the minimum does not defeat the fee.

POL-NS-06 produces no shortfall. The effective in-geofence dwell is 500 seconds against the 300 second STANDARD minimum, so the premature-cancellation route never opens, and the rider was in any event not exonerated because she was neither present at the kerb at cancellation nor entitled to POL-NS-04. I do not need POL-NS-06(i) accumulation at all, because the trace records no exit-and-re-entry to accumulate across; but for completeness, the traffic_advisory limb (i) depends on is MISSING (EV-ADVIS-00211-01, no payload, weight 0.0), which only makes limb (i) unavailable - it is citable as an absence, not as anything against the driver, and limb (ii) forbids any advisory from reducing the required minimum.

Compensation is payable and the anti-farming check does not trip. POL-NS-07 fixes compensation at 80 per cent of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee, that is SGD 3.20. The check requires BOTH no_show_terminations_30d of 4 or more AND a termination-to-completed-trip ratio above 0.08; EV-DPROF-00211 shows 2 terminations against 146 completed trips, a ratio of 0.014, so neither limb is met and the payout stands. The disposition of the fee itself is NO_ACTION, which on this rider-filed dispute leaves the SGD 4.00 charge standing as it presently is, while the ruling value follows the compensation.

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is present and this fee should not be held. The rider's trailing-30-day no-show disputes stand at 1, below the threshold of 3 in limb (d); the POL-NS-07 anti-farming branch does not trip; and neither party's disputes_with_counterparty_90d reaches 2 - both are 0 - so limb (c) is not met either. There is no repeat-behaviour or abuse pattern on either side of this trip.

If the judge takes the most adverse view available and holds that the continuous-dwell fact rests on the impaired trace alone, the outcome is still not a refund. POL-NS-08 sends that situation to escalation under POL-NS-09, where the fee is held rather than collected or refunded pending human review, because a 168 second recording gap is a defect in the measuring instrument, not evidence that a stationary driver drove away from the pickup.
